programme.title: Learn to Sew
programme.desc: Have you always wanted to learn how to Sew? Well now's your chance to have a lesson in the comfort of your own home. This easy to follow step by step programme will teach you the basics to get strated and then move on to some simple projects such as making a lined tote bag to practise what you have learnt. You will find out what equipment you'll need, larn some brilliant tips to make beautiful creations including a patchwork cushion and elasticated skirt!

programme.title: An Introduction to Tarot
programme.desc: Explore the mysteries and attraction of the ancient art of Tarot Cards. The cards might be centuries old but can still have an inexplicable power to help answer some of life's most important questions. In this programme we explain how to use the cards, shows the basic meaning of the pack and how to conduct a Tarot card reading. We conduct a reading and we can see for ourselves how to explain the possible card interpretations.

programme.title: Logan's Syndrome
programme.desc: How would you cope with two rare genetic diseases, one of which makes you look very different and the other one likely to kill you? What would you focus on to bring you happiness and help you feel like you belong in society? "Logan's Syndrome" is a personal documentary about one such man. Born to healthy parents, Logan Madsen and sister Heather share a life-threatening lung disease and Miller syndrome, which affects fewer than thirty people in the world.
